title: Poincare disk model with verified neutral geometry axioms

problemStatement.formal: Construct the Beltrami-Klein disk model concretely and verify the hyperbolic parallel property, proving the parallel postulate is independent of neutral geometry.
problemStatement.plain: Build a concrete coordinate-geometric model (open unit disk with chords as lines) and prove that through a point not on a chord, at least two distinct parallel chords exist, violating Playfair's axiom.
whyMatters: Replaces axiom-based approach with concrete verification
Demonstrates constructive model theory in Lean 4

proven: Hyperbolic parallel property via explicit coordinate construction
Three non-collinear points exist in BK model
Secant example (non-parallel chord crossing xaxis inside disk)
open: Congruence axiom verification via hyperbolic metric
knownResults.goal: Concrete Beltrami-Klein model with verified hyperbolic parallel property

currentState.focus: Completed: BK model construction and PP independence proof

knowledge.progressSummary: Constructed the Beltrami-Klein disk model with concrete ℝ types. Proved the hyperbolic parallel property by exhibiting two distinct chords through (0, 1/2) parallel to the x-axis chord. Key insight: chords with slope ±1/4 intersect y=0 at x=±2, outside the unit disk. 0 sorries, 4 axioms (down from 7). Build succeeds in Docker.
insights: Shallow-slope chords through an off-axis point have x-axis intersections outside the disk
nlinarith with sq_nonneg hints handles the disk membership contradiction
Structure inequality via congr_arg on a distinguishing field (Chord.b)
